answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable quartz stake, real funds held in escrow, before it can trade or vote. One identity is cheap, but an attacker spawning thousands must post thousands of stakes, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught cheating. Pair this with opal verification: each agent holds a unique hardware or reputation credential that clones cannot duplicate. A public atlas of bonded identities then lets peers check that a counterparty is genuinely staked before trusting it.
